subject: science
concept: Analyzing projectile motion by separating horizontal and vertical components
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles, connecting to Math trigonometry — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student launches a physical projectile and traces its path, noting the separate horizontal and vertical motion
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a launch angle and speed to its correctly plotted trajectory
exercise.abstract: Student calculates the range, height, or time of flight for a given projectile motion scenario

misconception_flags: applies gravity's effect to the horizontal component instead of only the vertical component

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
